name: timeline
purpose: A bar for the time t of a scene: drag it, press play, or jump to a marker. While the bar moves, the layers that ask for it show a faint copy at the earlier time.
keys: A/D one step, ⇧ for ten steps, Q/E the marker before and after, W play and pause

bind.doc: the state key of the time, a number

speed.doc: how much the time grows in each second of play; a tenth of the range if left out

loop.doc: play starts again at the end

markers.doc: [{"t": time, "label": name}] with names of at most 24 characters; they show on the bar and the learner can jump to them
